title: The TV asks for a pairing code
scenario: A pop-up on your smart TV says your streaming session expired and shows a QR code to “re-pair this device.” The page on your phone asks for your email password and a recovery code.

answers.A: Close the prompt and pair the TV only through the streaming service’s official app/device settings.
answers.B: Restart the TV/app and check whether it still requests pairing through the normal flow.
answers.C: Enter the password but withhold the recovery code unless the TV confirms the pairing.

explanation: Pairing should not require handing a recovery credential to an unfamiliar web page.
proTip: Pair devices from the account you trust, not the pop-up you did not request.
